approval_rule: Do not purchase data or activate a paid/test API until Hanno has reviewed the returned sample, quote, full terms, and projected cost per accepted strict URL.

items.question: Which mayoral candidacies, jurisdictions, election dates, stages, and years are retained historically?
Are campaign website values tied to a specific election and stage, or overwritten by the current profile?
Does each URL include the date first observed, last observed, or the dated record version from which it came?
Does each value identify its source and collection method, and may that provenance be retained in research files?
Can the 100-case result be delivered as CSV or JSON with one terminal row per requested case?
Is the masked 100-case feasibility sample free, and what minimum contract or setup charge applies?
What are the one-time and recurring prices for all unresolved in-scope cases, including API, export, support, and minimum-term charges?
Do the terms permit noncommercial academic research, internal matching, validation, and publication of aggregate results?
May accepted campaign URLs, source citations, and derived match decisions be stored, shared with coauthors, and released?
Which raw fields are confidential, and what safeguards prevent redistribution or bulk download?
What caching, retention, contract-end deletion, and audit-log requirements apply?
What citation, attribution, logo, or link-back language is required?
Are campaign URLs sourced from another vendor, and do upstream terms limit research use or redistribution?
What API rate limits, export limits, support terms, uptime commitments, and change-notice practices apply?
